objections.about: The customer asked whether the skills only work for coders. The reply never says plainly that the skills are usable in Cowork through upload, and it doesn't address that question.

Step 2 tells the customer to package only content-coach. The help page says to repeat the upload for each required skill and to install brand-brief, content-coach, post-writer and the others together for the writing workflow. The reply leaves out that content-coach runs the other skills.
The customer says they already restarted the laptop. The reply doesn't acknowledge this, so a person should check that the explanation fits what they tried.
